title: Undo by reconnecting the neighbours
hook: Removing a node need not erase the route for putting it back.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Restore a covered exact-cover column by reversing local linked-list unlink operations in reverse order.

misconception: Undoing constraint removal requires rebuilding the entire sparse matrix.
objective: Restore a covered exact-cover column by reversing local linked-list unlink operations in reverse order.

claims.text: Unlinking changes neighbouring pointers while keeping the removed node’s own neighbours. Uncover walks upward and leftward, undoing nested changes in reverse order. The final comparison checks every link and column size against the original sparse structure.
